title: ECL ACS binding exchange record v1
description: AC1-010: one hooked step's exchange between an OWASP ACS deployment and an ECL deployment, as an adapter retains it for audit: the negotiated failure posture, the Guardian's decision or decision failure and the channel through which the decision point obtained the decision, the decision inputs with their classes, the DCMP-2 messages, the release if there was one, and the ACS session chain entries that the recorded chain head covers. Dispositions are the wire values of the pinned ACS response envelope.

hook.description: The ACS method of the hooked step.

on_decision_failure.description: AC1-006: the failure posture the handshake negotiated.

audit_profile.description: True when the deployment claims the ACS-Audit profile.

failure.description: The kind of decision failure (AC1-006): no decision within the negotiated timeout, a transport failure, an error response without a decision, a disposition the mapping does not name, a decision for another request_id, an ACS signature that does not verify, or a decision that arrived after the safe state was applied.

observed_at.description: When the adapter received the decision or determined the failure.

channel.description: AC1-004: how the ECL decision point obtained the Guardian's decision: from the Guardian directly (direct), by verifying the Guardian's signature over it under a key that the governed AI system cannot use (signed), or through a hook point (hook). Required when the Guardian decided. On a failed exchange this names the attempted route and does not assert successful authentication.

key_id.description: AC1-004: the identifier of the key under which the decision point verified the Guardian's signature over the decision. Required when the channel is signed and the Guardian decided; on a failed exchange it is only attempted or unavailable evidence; a checker of the record cannot verify the signature itself, so this names what an assessor checks against the deployment.

request_digest.description: AC1-004: ecl.digest.sha-256.v1 of the UTF-8 RFC 8785 canonical form of the exact ACS request envelope params, excluding the envelope and signature. Required for a decided signed channel; on a failed signed route it is optional but accompanies retained request_params; this is the same hashing domain as ACS ContextEntry.request_hash.

result.description: The AcsResult of the Guardian's response envelope. Members this profile does not read are kept as the Guardian sent them.

request_params.description: AC1-004: the exact ACS request envelope params evaluated by the Guardian. On a failed signed route these are optional submitted params retained together with their local digest. The adapter checks their mapping into the DCMP request; this record does not contain the Guardian signature.

authenticated_context.description: AC1-004: the session, hooked step, method and params digest authenticated by the live adapter; dcmp_request_digest records the adapter-checked mapping to this DCMP request and is not claimed to be signed by the Guardian. These are retained assertions, not an offline signature proof. Required only for a decided signed exchange; retaining it on a failed route does not assert successful authentication.

method.description: The ACS method of the hooked step.

inputs.description: The inputs of the ECL decision: the entries of the decision basis that the response records in ecl.ext.decision-basis.v1, with the Guardian's decision marked by guardian (AC1-004, AC1-012).

guardian.description: True for the input that is the Guardian's decision, of which a record whose response carries ecl.ext.acs-decision.v1 has exactly one; its derived_from names the inputs that the Guardian's request carried (AC1-004).

modification_request.description: AC1-005: the new request for the action a modify produces.

chain.description: The ACS session chain from its first ContextEntry to the entry of this step.

contextEntry.description: An ACS ContextEntry in the form the pinned chain-hashing rule hashes; members this profile does not read are kept.

release.description: Present only when the enforcement point released the action: the decision request it went ahead under, the parameters digest it released and when.
